definitions.explanation: A box for receiving or sending mail, either a personal mailbox at one's home or a public collection box for posting letters.

examples.japanese: {郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}に{手紙|てがみ}が{届|とど}いていた。
examples.english: There was a letter in the mailbox.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}を{見|み}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I go check the mailbox every morning.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}の{横|よこ}に{新|あたら}しい{郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}を{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I installed a new mailbox beside the front entrance.

notes:
{郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ} can refer to either a private mailbox for receiving mail or a public red postbox for sending mail. In everyday speech, {郵便受|ゆうびんう}け is more common for a home receiving box, while ポスト is widely used for both types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}を{開|あ}ける — to open the mailbox
- {郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}に{投函|とうかん}する — to drop into the mailbox
- {郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}がいっぱいだ — the mailbox is full

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ポスト — mailbox; postbox (loanword, very common in daily conversation)
- {郵便受|ゆうびんう}け — mail slot; receiving mailbox (specifically for receiving)
- {私書箱|ししょばこ} — post office box (PO box, rented at a post office)
